root.label: C++20 Modules
root.note: Replaces textual header inclusion with semantic binary interfaces, explicit exports, and module linkage.

children.label: Module Isolation
children.note: Compiles an interface once semantically without leaking preprocessor state or parsing order.

children.label: Macro Encapsulation
children.note: Macros defined inside a named module never escape export boundaries to importers.

children.label: Order Independence
children.note: Importing named modules in any sequence produces identical lookup and compilation.

children.label: Unit Structure
children.note: A module unit transitions from global fragment through module purview to optional private fragment.

children.label: Global Module Fragment
children.note: Region between module; and export module M; reserved solely for legacy #include directives.

children.label: Module Purview
children.note: All declarations after the module declaration attach to that named module.

children.label: Private Module Fragment
children.note: Optional module :private; tail hiding single-TU implementation details from importers.

children.label: Visibility vs. Reachability
children.note: Exporting controls name lookup visibility while referenced unexported types stay reachable.

children.label: Visible Declarations
children.note: Exported names can be spelled directly by importing translation units.

children.label: Reachable Unexported Types
children.note: Return or parameter types omitted from export still work via auto and member access.

children.label: Linkage & TU-Local
children.note: Separates module-wide internal sharing from translation-unit-private symbols.

children.label: Module Linkage
children.note: Non-exported purview entities share one definition across units of the same module.

children.label: TU-Local Exposure
children.note: Exported inline functions and templates must not expose static or unnamed-namespace entities.

children.label: Partitions & Header Units
children.note: Supports modular sub-units internally and macro-preserving header imports for migration.

children.label: Module Partitions
children.note: Interface and internal partitions split module M and are importable only within M.

children.label: Header Units
children.note: Syntactic import <header>; builds a precompiled semantic unit while exporting macros.
